messages:
Olivia Grant: FYI Customer HelioOps reported being double-charged during their migration from Hosted -> Dedicated. Invoice INV-2026-1412 shows both hosted usage and a dedicated onboarding prorate for the same hours. Can we reconcile? @Marcus Li @Billing Bot
Marcus Li: ouch. can you paste the invoice lines and migration ticket id?
Olivia Grant: INV-2026-1412 lines:
- Hosted gen tokens: 2,000,000 @ $0.00075 = $1,500.00
- Dedicated onboarding prorate (applied) = $1,200.00
- Promo onboarding credit (applied) = -$1,200.00
- Net = $1,500.00
Migration ticket: MIG-2026-559. Customer says they should have been billed only for dedicated proration (net ~$1,500) not both hosted and dedicated for same usage window. Looks like the promo credit reversed only the dedicated onboarding, leaving hosted charge.
Billing Bot: Auto-validate: detected overlapping billing window between hosted and dedicated during migration window 2026-02-14 -> 2026-02-16. Ticket FIN-3784 created. Recommended remedy: issue customer credit equal to hosted charge if overlap confirmed and mark partner/promo accounting entries for reconciliation. GL: 4-2210.
Marcus Li: quick check  if dedicated onboarding credit and promo cancel each other then hosted $1,500 remains. If usage should have been attributed to dedicated only, we owe customer $1,500 credit. Confirm?
Carmen Alvarez: Confirmed with platform logs: the ingestion switch duplicated events for 2026-02-15 00:00-06:00. Usage was recorded on both hosted and dedicated. We should credit hosted line.
Olivia Grant: Customer asks for credit memo + a $100 goodwill for ops time. Approve?
Iris Patel: Approve credit memo for $1,500 and $100 goodwill one-off. Use credit memo (no cash) per policy. Please note in GL and tag migration ops for remediation. :white_check_mark:
Marcus Li: creating CM:
/create-credit --cust HelioOps --invoice INV-2026-1412 --amt 1600 --type credit_memo --reason "migration overlap double-charge"
System: CM-2026-0956 created and queued for EOD posting. FIN-3784 updated.
Billing Bot: CM-2026-0956 posted to invoice record; migration ops assigned to OPS-1216 for root-cause. Ledger note: GL 4-2210.
Olivia Grant: I'll send customer note: "We identified duplicate billing during your migration and issued a $1,600 credit memo (includes $100 goodwill). No action required. Apologies for the inconvenience."
Marcus Li: tagging Accounting to post before month close. Closing loop once posted.
Billing Bot: FIN-3784 closed after CM posted.
